trigger.Name: StartGame
trigger.script:
SetRadarUpgrade(1) PlayCustomMusic ("GameStart")
g_ObjCont:SetGameTime( 11, 0 , 15, 08, 2205 )
SetWeather( 0 )
AddQuestItem("quest_demo_photo") AddBelongToEncyclopaedia(1006) RuleConsole("cinematic_spring_coeff 5.7")
TakeQuest( "demo_KillMan_Quest" ) TakeQuest( "demo_MoveToGhostTown_Quest" ) EnableAutoHelp( false ) trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: trDemoPlaceSecret
trigger.script:
local gunlist = {"specter01","pkt01","storm01","kord01","vector01","vulcan01","rapier01"} local len = getn(gunlist)
for i=1,14 do CreateBoxWithAffixGun(CVector(getPos("SecretPlace"..i.."_loc")), gunlist[exrandom(len)], random(0, 2)) end trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: Trigger_NewCar
trigger.script:
local PlfPS = GetPlayerVehicle():GetProperty("Prototype").AsString if PlfPS == "MolokovozForSale" then CompleteQuest( "demo_GetMoney_Quest" ) SetVar("Molokovoz",1) TActivate ("TriggerSkladSinks") TActivate ("TriggerMyFriends")
ShowCircleOnMinimap( "demo", CVector(916, 306, 2509), 100 )
TDeactivate( "Trigger_NewCar2" ) trigger:Deactivate() end

trigger.Name: TriggerDefendIeriDie
trigger.script:
PlayCustomMusic("Submarina") TActivate ("RolikBegin_Bantits03")
local name = GetPlayerVehicle():GetName() local PC = GetPlayerVehicle():GetPosition() local PQ = GetPlayerVehicle():GetRotation() SetVar("PlCarName",name) CapturePlayerVehicle(0, "MemPlayer")
g_Player:AddChild(GetEntityByName("vehIeri"))
local PlNew=GetPlayerVehicle() if PlNew then PlNew:SetRotation(Quaternion(0.008, 0.697, 0.007, -0.717)) PlNew:SetGamePositionOnGround( CVector(818.260, 215.904, 756.671)) PlNew:setGodMode(1) end
local PlOld = getObj(name) if PlOld then PlOld:SetRotation(PQ) PlOld:SetGamePositionOnGround(PC) PlOld:setGodMode(1) end
getObj("SubmarinaR1M4"):StartMotionToPort()
trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: TriggerKillIeri
trigger.script:
if GetVar("Molokovoz").AsInt == 1 then TeamCreate("IeriBand",1007,CVector(2015,223,728),{"Demo_Ieri_Fighter_strong"},CVector(1938,222,806)) else TeamCreate("IeriBand",1007,CVector(2015,223,728),{"Demo_Ieri_Fighter"},CVector(1938,222,806)) end PlayCustomMusic("Combat_02") TActivate ("TriggerKillIeriDie")
trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: QUEST_BANDITS
trigger.script:
TeamCreate("Guard",1066,CVector(3241,223,2109),{"Demo_Pavel_Fighter"},CVector(3798,249,972), 1) local PavelCar = GetEntityByName("Guard_vehicle_0") PavelCar:SetSkin(2) TeamCreate("Bandits",1005,CVector(3834,249,945),{"Demo_Bandit_Scout","Demo_Bandit_Hunter","Demo_Bandit_Fighter"}, nil, 1) local BanditCar_00 = GetEntityByName("Bandits_vehicle_0") BanditCar_00:SetSkin(4) local BanditCar_01 = GetEntityByName("Bandits_vehicle_1") BanditCar_01:SetSkin(1) local BanditCar_02 = GetEntityByName("Bandits_vehicle_2") BanditCar_02:SetSkin(0) SetTolerance( 1100, 1005, RS_ENEMY ) SetTolerance( 1100, 1066, RS_ALLY ) TActivate("QUEST_BANDITS_END") TActivate("QUEST_BANDITS_FAIL")
trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: QUEST_BANDITS_END
trigger.script:
if IsQuestTaken("demo_new_KillBandits_Quest") then CompleteQuest( "demo_new_KillBandits_Quest_0" )
CinemaFiltersUse()
SaveAllToleranceStatus(RS_NEUTRAL)
local Plf = GetPlayerVehicle() local PlfID = GetPlayerVehicleId() local PlfCoor = Plf:GetPosition() PlfCoor.y = PlfCoor.y + 25*0.74 PlfCoor.z = PlfCoor.z + 25*0.74
Plf:SetCustomControlEnabled( true ) Plf:SetCustomLinearVelocity( 0 ) Plf:SetThrottle( 0 ) Plf:SetCustomControlEnabled( false )
FlyAround(1, 0, 25, 6, PlfCoor, PlfID, 1, 1 ) StartCinematic() AddCinematicMessage( 2222, 1 ) TActivate( "QUEST_BANDITS_Fade" ) TActivate( "QUEST_BANDITS_EndCinema" )
trigger:Deactivate() else trigger:Deactivate() end

trigger.Name: QUEST_BANDITS_Fade
trigger.script:
local FVehicle = GetEntityByName("Guard_vehicle_0") if FVehicle then FVehicle:Remove() end
trigger:Deactivate()
